_readme: [pipeline 7]P-2 + P-6. One row per produced item, and the relationship the guard checks is
count(rows) == count(items) in BOTH directions — because the failure mode P-2 exists for is NOT
logging, and a criterion satisfied by an empty log rewards exactly that.
🔴 EVERY ROW HERE SAYS `none/hand-authored` OR `none/hand-constructed`, AND THAT IS THE TRUTH RATHER
THAN A PLACEHOLDER. This example pack was written by a person and its two binary assets are
deterministic container headers assembled by tooling. No model produced any of it, so no row claims
a model, no row claims a SynthID mark, and no row claims a licence it cannot support. A generated
pack's rows name a real generator_model_id and a real prompt; the shape is identical.
`prompt` is REQUIRED on every row, including these — an authoring instruction is what was asked for,
and the [ADR 019] ban-list scan applies to it exactly as it would to a model prompt. Allowing an
empty prompt 'because no model ran' is how the field becomes optional in practice.

items.prompt: Write the single most common everyday greeting in each declared locale, in the form a traveller would say it to a stranger.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Write the ordinary spoken form of thanks in each declared locale, neutral register, no honorific escalation.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Write the question a traveller asks to locate the railway station, in each declared locale, as a complete spoken sentence.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Write the question asking the price of an item being pointed at, in each declared locale, market register.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Write the shortest polite request for drinking water in each declared locale, as said to a server.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Write the plain urgent statement that the speaker needs medical help, in each declared locale, no idiom.
items.marking_reason: not model output — a person wrote it, so there is no generated-content marking duty to discharge

items.prompt: Assemble a minimal lossless WebP container: RIFF header, WEBP form type, one VP8L chunk. Structure only — this asset exists to give the format allowlist a real subject, not to be looked at.
items.marking_reason: not model output — deterministic bytes assembled by tooling, no model involved, so there is no SynthID to preserve and none is claimed

items.prompt: Assemble one MPEG-1 Layer III frame at 128 kbps / 44.1 kHz with a zero payload. Structure only — this asset exists to give the format allowlist a real subject.
items.marking_reason: not model output — deterministic bytes assembled by tooling. Note that a REAL Chirp 3 HD asset would also read `none` here: Chirp applies no watermark at all, so PROVENANCE.json is audio's only marking evidence either way
